command: if python3 -m venv .venv 2>/dev/null; then echo "venv ok"; .venv/bin/pip install --quiet pytest && .venv/bin/python -m pytest test_fmtcsv.py -v; else echo "venv failed, using --target"; python -m pip install --quiet --target=.pylibs pytest && PYTHONPATH=.pylibs python -m pytest test_fmtcsv.py -v; fi
title: Set up local pytest and run tests
